title: Settings & Staff
passwordTooShort: New password must be at least 8 characters
newReviewNotificationsHint: Get notified when a customer leaves a review
newBookingNotificationsHint: Get notified for new chef table bookings

publishReview.title: Publish Review
publishReview.notSubmittedHint: Once your profile, menu, and photos are ready, submit for a one-time admin review before your listing goes live.
publishReview.pendingBody: An admin is reviewing your profile. This usually takes a day or two.
publishReview.approvedBody: Your listing has been approved and is live.
publishReview.rejectedBody: Your submission needs a few changes before it can go live. Update your profile and submit again.

staffHint: Invite staff with limited access — they can help manage the menu without touching your profile or account settings.
inviteValidation: Fill in name, email, and an 8+ character password.

deleteAccount.title: Delete Account
deleteAccount.hint: Permanently deletes this restaurant's entire profile — menu, photos, staff, reviews, everything. This can't be undone.
deleteAccount.hintStaff: Permanently removes your own staff login. The restaurant's account and data are not affected.
deleteAccount.confirmBody: This permanently deletes the entire restaurant profile — menu, photos, staff accounts, reviews, everything. This cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.confirmBodyStaff: This permanently removes your own staff login. You will be signed out and won't be able to sign back in unless invited again.
deleteAccount.errorBody: Something went wrong. Please try again.
